runs.text: The engine computes the value of every constant
. Using it is the same as writing its value: it takes no box in memory and cannot be changed.

blocks.title: Constants of an invoice

blocks.description: A declaration of the constant SEMANA as 7 * 24 that is computed as 168. The line Write base, SEMANA becomes Write base, 168. Only base appears in memory; the constant has no box.

caption.text: The engine replaces each constant with its value before running. Only variables remain in memory.

The value is computed with a subset of expressions: literals, other constants, enumeration members, parentheses, signs,
and concatenation. Variables, function calls and power are not allowed.
